representation: GF(2) RREF plus hash-consed bounded-fanin Boolean DAG with definitional auxiliaries

ledger_split.irreversibility_ledger: polynomial collision/quotient certificates may prove that a transition is not a reversible re-encoding
ledger_split.projection_ledger: checker must verify exact equivalence between the next state and the existential projection represented by the transition certificate
ledger_split.existential_debt_ledger: an eliminated semantic choice that is not already definitionally determined creates a debt item unless a polynomial-size checked witness-selection/Skolem rule is supplied
ledger_split.complexity_ledger: state size, certificate size, transition time, reconstruction time and replay time must all remain polynomial in original input length

first_candidate.name: SKOLEM_DEBT_V1
rules: eliminating an unresolved original semantic bit without a checked witness-selection rule decreases live bits by one and increases debt by one, hence claims zero progress
a debt item may be discharged only by a polynomial-size independently checked witness-selection rule or a certified terminal argument showing the choice is irrelevant to the terminal SAT/UNSAT result
renaming, DAG refactoring, affine basis changes and fresh aliases may not discharge debt
strict progress is claimed only when the total potential decreases
first_candidate.terminal_requirement: TRUE/FALSE with zero live original semantic bits and zero undischarged existential debt; SAT additionally reconstructs one original assignment

positive_controls: unit-forced variable with constant witness selection
affine-pivot variable with linear witness selection
free variable with fixed default witness selection
single OR clause where an eliminated variable has a constant satisfying selection
negative_controls: projection with no supplied witness-selection rule
first_hostile_question: Can SKOLEM_DEBT_V1 discharge every debt created by arbitrary PAIR+OR_3 elimination using polynomial-size rules and polynomially checkable exact certificates without becoming equivalent to solving the original SAT instance?
killer_condition: a debt item can be falsely discharged by an alias/re-encoding, or an exact required witness-selection/projection certificate necessarily falls outside the frozen polynomial verification contract for the candidate
candidate_condition: one uniform algorithm discharges all debt and reaches exact TRUE/FALSE with polynomial total cost on every PAIR+OR_3 input
